invocations.rendering: Besides the transforms, scripts/render_invocation.py cuts every tool-call argument string longer than 300 characters and marks the cut as ...[N more characters]. It writes only each call's name, arguments and status, not tool output, and the final message, copied except for the declared path and hostname replacements. The calls file holds each call's name and full, uncut arguments, with the same replacements.
